Step 3. By the holomorphic spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01380013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the holomorphic spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via perturbative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
